In this video, we explore one of Carl Jung's stranger theories about psychology and reality: Synchronicity. Though often grossly misunderstood or misrepresented, this idea is much more robust when considered in Jungian terms. Regardless of its underlying truth, the idea brings into question the patterns of our lives and the nature of existence. Are things merely a coincidence? Or is there something more at play?
